{{Quote|Gormak armor. Powerful. Smuggled to village. Then sent elsewhere.|Abdan-Sho|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Abdan-Sho''' was a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Voss commandos|commando]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] Abdan-Sho and the Republic [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Kelnu Velus]] surveyed the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] fortifications on the [[Fest Otur Island]] north of the [[Nightmare Lands]]. They asked a Republic-aligned individual to retrieve experimental powered armor from the Gormak and destroy the power stations used to make it.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T5-BD]] erroneously refers to Abdan-Sho as "Adban-Sho" when giving players the mission "Fishing Facade."<ref name="TOR" />
